messages:
jules: FYI customer reported rerank failures after onboarding our new batching helper in their canary. quick log: 
```
Error: embedding dimension mismatch: found 1536 != 768 during dot product
at rerank_handler.go:88
```
jules: minimal repro: node sampleapp (sdk 0.7.x) produced 1536-length vectors; python sampleapp (sdk 0.5.x) produced 768. they rolled both into the same rerank call
sam: sounds like pad_to_max default drift between SDKs. did we change the Node default in last minor?
devex-jen: yes, Node flip to pad_to_max=true went out in 0.7.0. python stayed false. issue RED-122 tracked but not shipped across all samples
jules: customer impact: feature degraded during canary, support ticket P1. they surfaced duplicate send after auth refresh too (caused mixed padded vs non-padded embeds in store)\sam: short-term ops fix: add a preflight check in sampleapp that asserts all embeddings have same length and returns a clear client error with guidance ("check sdk.pad_to_max parity or call metadata endpoint for embedding_dim")
devex-jen: long-term: server should attach embedding_dim to batch embedding responses and rerank should validate uniform dims and return structured error code EMB_DIM_MISMATCH + hint about sdk versions\sdk-bot: created issue RED-embed-421: "SDK pad_to_max parity + embedding_dim metadata" assigned to @sam
sam: I'll open SDK PRs to standardize pad_to_max default to false and add embedding_dim on EmbeddingResponse. will add a small integration test that mixes Node/Python clients in CI\jules: also adding an idempotency token to batch requests so retries during auth refresh don't duplicate mixed-state records\devex-jen: good. please add an entry in release notes and a short blurb in onboarding sampleapp that prints the returned embedding_dim so users notice mismatch early\jules: rolling a hotfix that bails with better error message while we ship the SDK/server changes. notified customer and they confirm rollforward fixed the canary :thumbsup:
